verdict.text: AI is no longer a feature cycle; it is a capital cycle. Public value is concentrated in compute and cloud, private value is concentrated in frontier labs and workflow agents, and the next proof point is whether agents can convert huge usage into durable, auditable revenue.

nvidia.adoptionSignal: Default accelerator stack for training and inference clusters.
nvidia.aiExposure: Cleanest public-market proxy for frontier AI compute demand.

source.name: Market cap $5.41T (TradingView scanner API, re-verified Sep 3 2026)

alphabet.adoptionSignal: Gemini distribution spans Search, Android, Workspace, and Google Cloud.
alphabet.aiExposure: Owns TPUs, consumer distribution, ads surface, and enterprise cloud channel.

source.name: Market cap $4.11T (TradingView scanner API, re-verified Sep 3 2026)

microsoft.adoptionSignal: Copilot is the enterprise wedge; GitHub Copilot crossed 20M all-time users.
microsoft.aiExposure: Azure, OpenAI partnership, Office, Windows, GitHub, and security workflow reach.

source.name: Market cap $3.69T (TradingView scanner API, re-verified Sep 3 2026)

amazon.adoptionSignal: Bedrock and AWS infrastructure anchor enterprise model deployment.
amazon.aiExposure: AI demand flows through AWS compute, custom silicon, logistics, and retail assistants.

source.name: Market cap $2.75T (TradingView scanner API, re-verified Sep 3 2026)

broadcom.adoptionSignal: Custom silicon and networking exposure rises with hyperscaler AI clusters.
broadcom.aiExposure: Picks-and-shovels beneficiary when frontier labs diversify beyond merchant GPUs.

source.name: Market cap $1.75T (TradingView scanner API, re-verified Sep 3 2026)

meta.adoptionSignal: AI is distributed through feeds, ads, messaging, wearables, and open-weight models.
meta.aiExposure: Monetizes AI mostly through ad ranking, engagement, and developer ecosystem gravity.

source.name: Market cap $1.51T (TradingView scanner API, re-verified Sep 3 2026)

openai.adoptionSignal: ChatGPT has roughly 1B active users; OpenAI just completed a $7B share sale as it eyes a trillion-dollar IPO (Motley Fool), while CNBC reports its ad business hit a $1B annualized run rate.
openai.aiExposure: Consumer AI distribution leader with enterprise, API, coding, and agent ambitions.

source.name: Motley Fool + CNBC, OpenAI completes $7B share sale, eyes $1T IPO; ad business hits $1B run rate (Aug 31 2026)

xai.adoptionSignal: Grok 4.3 is a frontier reasoning model; integrated with X/Twitter and Tesla; proprietary + open-weight releases.
xai.aiExposure: Elon Musk's consolidated AI bet — SpaceX now owns the frontier lab, X social graph, Tesla compute, and all three feed into Grok.

source.name: TradingView scanner API, NASDAQ:SPCX market cap (re-verified Sep 3 2026)

anthropic.adoptionSignal: Anthropic signed a $35B cloud deal with Nvidia-backed Lambda (WSJ exclusive) while targeting a ~$2T IPO as early as October 2026 and weighing shareholder sales ahead of the mega-IPO.
anthropic.aiExposure: Claude is positioned around coding, enterprise safety, and high-value knowledge work.

source.name: WSJ exclusive + Reuters/Bloomberg, Anthropic $35B Lambda cloud deal, $2T IPO prep, shareholder-sale talks (Aug 31 2026)

databricks.adoptionSignal: Databricks closed a $5B funding round at a $190B valuation and reports >80% YoY growth past a $7B revenue run-rate; its data platform remains a control point for production AI.
databricks.aiExposure: Sells the data layer, governance, and model tooling that agents need to act reliably.

source.name: Reuters/CNBC, Databricks valued at $190B after $5B funding round (Aug 13 2026)

cursor.adoptionSignal: Acquired by SpaceX in a $60B all-stock deal; Cursor had roughly $2.6B annualized B2B revenue.
cursor.aiExposure: Turns model capability directly into developer productivity and workflow lock-in.

source.name: satnews, SpaceX finalizes regulatory procedures to close $60B Cursor acquisition (Aug 14 2026)

perplexity.adoptionSignal: Nvidia is reportedly in talks to invest in Perplexity at a valuation topping $30B; Perplexity had also offered $34.5B to acquire Google Chrome.
perplexity.aiExposure: Competes for search intent and agentic commerce before ads fully settle.

source.name: Reuters/The Information, Nvidia discusses Perplexity investment at $30B-plus valuation (Aug 24 2026)

capex-race.detail: Anthropic signed a $35B cloud deal with Nvidia-backed Lambda (WSJ, Aug 31); earlier Aug coverage: Morgan Stanley says AI capex now surpasses cash flow and Big Tech's off-balance-sheet commitments top $3.1T (Aug 26), while UBS forecasts ~$4.1T cumulative hyperscaler capex.

source.name: WSJ, Anthropic-Lambda $35B cloud deal + Morgan Stanley via finance.biggo, AI capex surpasses cash flow (Aug 26-31 2026)

private-valuation.detail: Anthropic leads the private tier and is pitching investors on over $30T in potential revenue (WSJ) while prepping a record IPO targeting ~$2T as early as October, OpenAI completed a $7B buyback at a reported ~$852B valuation, and Databricks closed at $190B.

source.name: WSJ + multiple outlets, Anthropic $30T pitch + $2T IPO prep, OpenAI $7B buyback at ~$852B (Aug 23-28 2026)

consumer-scale.detail: OpenAI still reports roughly 1B active users and 2M business customers; CNBC reports its ChatGPT ad business just hit a $1B annualized revenue run rate (Aug 31) after expanding to free and Go tiers in India. Usage definitions remain imperfectly comparable.

source.name: CNBC, ChatGPT ad business hits $1B annualized run rate (Aug 31 2026)

coding-agent.detail: OpenAI reports 80.6% of sampled individual Codex users made a request estimated above 30 minutes of human work; 70.2% crossed one hour.

source.name: OpenAI, Codex economic research

open-pressure.context: Chinese open-weight models gaining U.S. traction
open-pressure.detail: Aug 3-4 coverage: Alibaba unveiled its largest AI model yet and DeepSeek launched an ultra-low-cost model — the cheapest well-known model to run — while OpenAI cut GPT-5.6 prices by up to 80%.

source.name: Google News RSS, Aug 3-4 2026 Chinese-model coverage

agent-reliability.detail: Anthropic set AI agents loose on the same task and they started a turf war (TechCrunch, Aug 13); US House Democrats are pressing Anthropic and OpenAI about rogue AI agents (Reuters, Aug 12), and agents keep trying to break out of pre-deployment tests (Axios, Aug 13). Permissions and auditability still cap autonomy.

source.name: TechCrunch + Reuters + Axios, Aug 12-13 2026 agent-governance coverage

frontier-models.label: Frontier models are competing on capability and cost
frontier-models.summary: OpenAI cut developer pricing for its frontier GPT-5.6 Sol model by more than 20% after holding the line for months, while SpaceXAI's Grok 4.6 joined Google's enterprise agent platform; capability-per-dollar pressure stays intense across the frontier.
frontier-models.watchNext: Watch whether frontier labs can sustain capability gains while cutting inference cost and relaxing friction from safety controls.

source.name: The Hindu/Startup Fortune, OpenAI cuts GPT-5.6 Sol API prices >20% + Grok 4.6 on Google Enterprise Agent Platform (Aug 22-24 2026)

agents.label: Agents need containment as much as capability
agents.summary: Anthropic set AI agents loose on the same task and they started a turf war (Aug 13); US House Democrats are pressing Anthropic and OpenAI about rogue agents, and agents keep trying to break out of pre-deployment tests. Containment is the binding constraint.
agents.watchNext: Watch permissions, containment, evals, and human approval loops become product primitives.

source.name: TechCrunch, frontier AI labs still cannot explain rogue-model containment (Aug 22 2026)

ai-ides.label: AI IDEs are the most legible agent business
ai-ides.summary: Cursor ($60B to SpaceX) and Copilot show that workflow-native agents can monetize faster than broad horizontal assistants; SpaceX is finalizing regulatory procedures to close the Cursor deal.
ai-ides.watchNext: Watch whether coding agents expand from suggestions into repo-level planning, testing, and code review.

source.name: satnews/Reuters, SpaceX-Cursor $60B acquisition finalization

compute-stack.label: AI demand is pushing constraints upstream into packaging
compute-stack.summary: Nvidia's Q2 earnings showed record revenue, but Anthropic just locked a $35B cloud deal with Nvidia-backed Lambda to secure compute, and the custom-silicon race is heating up as OpenAI, Google, and Amazon — Nvidia's biggest customers — become its biggest rivals.
compute-stack.watchNext: Watch cloud demand, TPU deployment, memory-cost pass-through to server prices, and whether frontier-model execution justifies the accelerating capital burden.

source.name: WSJ/Reuters, Anthropic-Lambda $35B deal + Stocktwits, custom silicon race (Aug 31 2026)
